dogecoin.text: So happy for all the early Dogecoin holders, I will never judge or scoff at you. IMO it is extremely naive to buy Doge at current levels. The fundamentals compared to the valuation is downright egregious. So many bag holders got in at <$0.01. Too many coins stowed in Robinhood.

Everybody thought I was crazy for owning Bitcoin the last 4 years

Everybody thinks we’re crazy for saying Dogecoin is going to get WREKT. 

Bullish again. Bitcoiners always prevail.
